g.text: Public AEMO CSVs verified and loaded to DuckDB
Ground truth computed by deterministic SQL (no model)
Model's SQL executed read-only and compared with the truth
cmd: just nem-data | pass: five 'PRICE_AND_DEMAND_202509_<region>.csv: OK' lines against configs/nem-priceanddemand.sha256, then '<region>: 8640 intervals' for each region
cmd: just demo-timeseries-qa | pass: prints 'ground truth (deterministic SQL, no model): Q1=[...]; ...' before any question is asked
cmd: just demo-timeseries-qa | pass: a row per question with PASS or FAIL; failing rows show expected values, returned values and the SQL
cmd: just demo-timeseries-qa | pass: prints 'summary: arm 1 (plain text-to-SQL), <model>: N/10 questions match the ground truth'

cmd: just ao-load-nem && just demo-timeseries-ao | pass: prints 'ao-load-nem: demo.price_demand rows=43200', then a row per question with PASS or FAIL, steps and seconds, and 'summary: arm 2 (Auto Ontology): N/10 questions match the ground truth' (arm 2)

cmd: just demo-timeseries-metrics | pass: a row per question with PASS or FAIL, and 'summary: arm 3 (governed metric catalogue), <model>: N/10 questions match the ground truth' (arm 3: the model picks a metric from configs/nem-metrics.json, fixed SQL computes)
